The structure of Sr₂Eu₂Bi₈O₂₄ (SrEu(BiO₃)₄) adopts orthorhombic Cmcm symmetry (space group 63) with 36 atoms per unit cell across six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Bi in octahedral coordination by six O neighbors and Eu in a close-packed-like 12-neighbor arrangement with O, while Sr shows 10 O neighbors. Corner-sharing between Bi octahedra is observed, and polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing Bi octahedra with Sr 10-vertex polyhedra and face-sharing between Eu 12-vertex polyhedra and Sr 10-vertex polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 36 sites.
